catalogue.note: synthetic catalogue; part families shaped on the public DISCMAM use cases and common sustainment items; no part is a real item from any fleet

lpbf_base.label: Laser powder-bed fusion at the home centre
lpbf_base.source: Nikon SLM Solutions SLM 280 build volume 280 x 280 x 365 mm; DTI prints DISCMAM parts on an SLM 280 (AM Media, Jul 2026)

lpbf_container.label: Laser powder-bed fusion in a deployable container
lpbf_container.source: assumed: a container-class LPBF machine one size below the SLM 280; Fieldmade's NOMAD03 envelope is not published in the sources used

ded.label: Directed energy deposition (wire or powder, robot-mounted)
ded.source: assumed: a robot-cell DED envelope; DTI has tested a Meltio DED system (GTS DED theme day, Sep 2025)

cast aluminium.source: AlSi10Mg is DTI's listed aluminium; DISCMAM's Belgian MoD parts were printed in AlSi10Mg

steel.source: 1.2709 is in DTI's alloy list (tekniq.dk, May 2023)

stainless.source: 316L parameters co-developed by DTI and SLM Solutions (Apr 2023)

titanium.source: Ti6Al4V in DTI's alloy list; CHIPART works on titanium chip recycling

copper alloy.source: CuCr1Zr parameters co-developed by DTI and SLM Solutions (Apr 2023)

bronze.source: no bronze in DTI's published alloy list; a bearing bronze part needs a substitution study

polymer.source: nylon (SLS) is DTI's listed polymer; SLS envelope not modelled here

assumptions.powder_price_note: powder prices are order-of-magnitude assumptions per kilogram, editable in the page
assumptions.deposition_note: single-laser build rates, assumed from public machine literature, editable
assumptions.qualification_note: one-off cost to qualify a part family: witness coupons, CT, engineering time; scaled by criticality; assumed

gates.density_permanent_source: DISCMAM's permanent-use density threshold, AM Media, Jul 2026
gates.tier_note: the four tiers (permanent, temporary, emergency, scrap) are DISCMAM's; the 99.5 and 99.0 thresholds and the sign-off rules are this console's illustrative policy, not DTI's
gates.self_supporting_source: the usual published rule of thumb for LPBF overhangs; steeper needs support

weights.note: weights are this console's; the page prints them so they can be argued with
